headline: A seat at the high table was demanded

facts.text: {SLIGHTED} demanded in front of everyone that {FAVORED} give up the seat of honor
in the hall of {SETTLEMENT}
saying that, as the head of {SLIGHTED.his} house, {SLIGHTED.he} should not sit below a member of another
and the whole hall fell silent

headline: A slight at the table was swallowed

facts.text: {SLIGHTED} swallowed the insult of sitting below {FAVORED}
in the hall of {SETTLEMENT}
and said nothing, though it plainly stung

headline: A seat was given up

facts.text: {SLIGHTED} graciously gave the seat of honor to {FAVORED}
in the hall of {SETTLEMENT}
and raised a cup to {FAVORED.him}

headline: A lord walked out of the hall

facts.text: {SLIGHTED} walked out of {HOST}'s feast
in {SETTLEMENT}
on seeing {SLIGHTED.his} seat was below {FAVORED}'s

headline: A veteran taught what he knew

facts.text: {VETERAN} told {STUDENT} how that campaign was really won
in {SETTLEMENT}
and held nothing back, down to {VETERAN.his} own mistakes

headline: A request for counsel was brushed off

facts.text: {VETERAN} gave {STUDENT} only a few things everyone already knows
in {SETTLEMENT}
and changed the subject before the cup was empty

headline: A request for counsel was mocked

facts.text: {VETERAN} made a joke of {STUDENT}'s questions in front of the hall
in {SETTLEMENT}
saying some men should first learn to sit still
and the laughter followed {STUDENT} out of the hall

headline: A boast was told over drinks

facts.text: {SPEAKER} boasted to {LISTENER} of deeds that grew with every cup
in a tavern in {SETTLEMENT}
and the others at the table only smiled

headline: A private worry was let slip over drinks

facts.text: {SPEAKER} confided to {LISTENER} that {SPEAKER.his} coffers were all but empty
over drinks in {SETTLEMENT}
and asked that it go no further

headline: Sour words were spoken over drinks

facts.text: {SPEAKER} said something to {LISTENER} over drinks, and {LISTENER}'s face changed on the spot
in a tavern in {SETTLEMENT}
and did not take it back once the wine had worn off

headline: A good word was spoken over drinks

facts.text: {SPEAKER} stood up for {LISTENER} against the mockery at the table
in a tavern in {SETTLEMENT}
and said it was not the wine talking

headline: The credit for a victory was claimed

facts.text: {CLAIMANT} claimed the credit for the last victory in front of the whole hall
in the hall of {SETTLEMENT}
saying {RIVAL} rode up only after the line had already broken

headline: The credit for a victory was given away

facts.text: {CLAIMANT} handed {RIVAL} the credit for the last victory
in the hall of {SETTLEMENT}
though the hall had been ready to praise {CLAIMANT} instead

headline: A victory was belittled

facts.text: {CLAIMANT} told a few trusted ears that {RIVAL} did nothing in the last battle
in {SETTLEMENT}
and took care to say it only when {RIVAL} was out of earshot

headline: A dispute over credit was put to the host

facts.text: {HOST} settled the quarrel between {CLAIMANT} and {RIVAL} over the last victory
in the hall of {SETTLEMENT}
and gave the credit to {RIVAL}

headline: A retainer was handed over after a brawl

facts.text: {PATRON} handed over the man who drew first and made {PATRON.his} apology to {AGGRIEVED}
in {SETTLEMENT}
with the whole market square watching

headline: A lord shielded his own after a brawl

facts.text: {PATRON}'s men and {AGGRIEVED}'s men fought, and {PATRON} refused to hand the man over to {AGGRIEVED}
in {SETTLEMENT}
saying {PATRON.his} house deals with its own and it's no one else's business

headline: A brawl ended in counter-accusation

facts.text: {PATRON}'s men and {AGGRIEVED}'s men fought, and {PATRON} refused to hand anyone over and said {AGGRIEVED}'s men struck first
in {SETTLEMENT}
and demanded that the other house answer first
neither house gave an inch

headline: A brawl was hushed up

facts.text: {AGGRIEVED} and {PATRON} agreed to let the market brawl die quietly
in {SETTLEMENT}
and both houses agreed never to speak of it again

headline: A hunting wager was struck

facts.text: {CHALLENGER} and {CHALLENGED} struck a wager on the next hunt
in {SETTLEMENT}
and half the hall put silver on it as well

headline: A hunting wager was refused

facts.text: {CHALLENGED} refused {CHALLENGER}'s wager and made a joke of the asking
in {SETTLEMENT}
and the hall laughed for quite a while

headline: A hunting wager had a hidden stake

facts.text: {CHALLENGER} and {CHALLENGED} put more than silver on the next hunt
in {SETTLEMENT}
and neither of them would say what it was

headline: A lord spoke ill of the ruler in private

facts.text: {SPEAKER} said that {RULER} wasn't fit to sit on that throne
at {SETTLEMENT}
and said it to {LISTENER} in private

headline: A prisoner was mistreated

facts.text: {CAPTOR} chained {PRISONER} on the same line as the common prisoners
driven along the whole way
fed on what the others left over

headline: A comrade's plea for aid was refused

facts.text: {ASKER} asked {REFUSER} for a loan of grain; {REFUSER} had grain on hand, yet didn't lend a single sack
at {SETTLEMENT}
{REFUSER} said {REFUSER.he} was hard-pressed too
{REFUSER}'s grain cart was standing right there in the courtyard, full to the brim

headline: A rash pursuit ended in capture

facts.text: {PRISONER} left {PRISONER.his} own troops behind to give chase, and that was how {CAPTOR} caught {PRISONER.him}
near {SETTLEMENT}
with only a few riders
surrounded when {CAPTOR} wheeled around

headline: Foul play

facts.text: {VICTIM} didn't die peacefully of old age; {POISONER} poisoned {VICTIM.him}
the poison was in the wine
{POISONER} had sent that jug of wine

headline: A lord spoke ill of the ruler in private

facts.text: {DENIER} came forward to clear up the rumor that {DENIER.he} had spoken ill of the ruler behind {RULER.his} back
publicly at {SETTLEMENT}
and said anyone who didn't believe it was welcome to go and ask {DENIER.him} face to face

headline: A prisoner was mistreated

facts.text: {DENIER} came forward to clear up the rumor that {DENIER.he} had mistreated a prisoner
publicly at {SETTLEMENT}
and said anyone who didn't believe it was welcome to go and ask {DENIER.him} face to face

headline: A comrade's plea for aid was refused

facts.text: {DENIER} came forward to clear up the rumor that {DENIER.he} had refused a comrade's plea for aid
publicly at {SETTLEMENT}
and said anyone who didn't believe it was welcome to go and ask {DENIER.him} face to face

headline: A rash pursuit ended in capture

facts.text: {DENIER} came forward to clear up the rumor that {DENIER.he} had been taken prisoner through {DENIER.his} own recklessness
publicly at {SETTLEMENT}
and said anyone who didn't believe it was welcome to go and ask {DENIER.him} face to face

headline: Foul play

facts.text: {DENIER} came forward to clear up the rumor that {DENIER.he} had poisoned {VICTIM}
publicly at {SETTLEMENT}
and said anyone who didn't believe it was welcome to go and ask {DENIER.him} face to face

headline: A rash pursuit ended in capture

facts.text: {CAPTOR} came forward and said that {PRISONER} hadn't left {PRISONER.his} own troops behind, and was only captured by {CAPTOR.him} after fighting to the end
in front of everyone at {SETTLEMENT}
it was {CAPTOR.he} who captured {PRISONER}

headline: A rash pursuit ended in capture

facts.text: {BYSTANDER} came forward and said that {BYSTANDER.he} was there when {PRISONER} was captured, and {PRISONER} hadn't left {PRISONER.his} own troops behind
in front of everyone at {SETTLEMENT}
{PRISONER} still had {PRISONER.his} own men around {PRISONER.him}

headline: A prisoner was mistreated

facts.text: {PRISONER} came forward and said that while {CAPTOR} held {PRISONER.him} prisoner, {CAPTOR.he} didn't chain {PRISONER.him} together with the common prisoners
in front of everyone at {SETTLEMENT}
fed the same as {CAPTOR}'s own men

headline: A prisoner was mistreated

facts.text: {COMRADE} came forward and said that {COMRADE.he} was in the army too while {CAPTOR} held {PRISONER} prisoner, and {PRISONER} wasn't chained together with the common prisoners
in front of everyone at {SETTLEMENT}
fed the same as their own men

headline: A comrade's plea for aid was refused

facts.text: {ASKER} came forward and said {ASKER.he} never asked {REFUSER} for a loan of grain
in front of everyone at {SETTLEMENT}
the talk that {REFUSER} had grain and wouldn't lend {ASKER.him} any has no truth to it

headline: The credit for a victory was given away

facts.text: {RIVAL} came forward to clear up the rumor that {CLAIMANT} had given {RIVAL.him} the credit
publicly at {SETTLEMENT}
and said {RIVAL.he} had no idea where the talk had come from

headline: A veteran taught what he knew

facts.text: {STUDENT} came forward to clear up the rumor that {VETERAN} had taught {STUDENT.him} everything {VETERAN.he} knew
publicly at {SETTLEMENT}
and said {STUDENT.he} had no idea where the talk had come from

headline: A retainer was handed over after a brawl

facts.text: {AGGRIEVED} came forward to clear up the rumor that {PATRON} had handed over {PATRON.his} man and apologized to {AGGRIEVED.him}
publicly at {SETTLEMENT}
and said {AGGRIEVED.he} had no idea where the talk had come from

headline: A seat was given up

facts.text: {FAVORED} came forward to clear up the rumor that {SLIGHTED} had given up {SLIGHTED.his} seat to {FAVORED.him} at a feast
publicly at {SETTLEMENT}
and said {FAVORED.he} had no idea where the talk had come from

headline: A good word was spoken over drinks

facts.text: {LISTENER} came forward to clear up the rumor that {SPEAKER} had stood up for {LISTENER.him} over drinks
publicly at {SETTLEMENT}
and said {LISTENER.he} had no idea where the talk had come from
